from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AccountsPayableRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the Accounts Payable information extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company (registrant) in this filing")
    accounts_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the Accounts Payable line item as reported")
    reporting_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the reported amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for the liability in the financial statements")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    records: list[AccountsPayableRecord]
